content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

For creators in Kenya, the concept of infrastructure sovereignty offers a chance to break free from the limitations of traditional payment processing models. With this approach, the focus shifts from relying on third-party services to building one's own digital commerce stack using free and open-source tools. This means using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack provides creators with full control over their digital commerce infrastructure and enables them to sell ebooks to international buyers without relying on Stripe or other restricted payment platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Considering the restrictions imposed by Stripe and other payment platforms, infrastructure sovereignty emerges as a viable solution for creators in restricted countries. By leveraging free and open-source tools, they can build their own digital commerce stacks that operate independently of these platforms. This way, they can sell ebooks to international buyers without facing the limitations imposed by Stripe's restrictions. Furthermore, leveraging blockchain-based payments, such as NOWPayments, enables creators to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This flexibility is particularly beneficial for creators in countries with limited access to traditional payment methods.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, the infrastructure sovereignty approach offers a compelling alternative to traditional payment processing models. Using NOWPayments, creators can accept payments in a matter of seconds, with fees as low as $0.10 for USDT on Tron transactions. In comparison, traditional payment processing platforms often charge higher fees and impose longer processing times, making them less suitable for creators who value speed and flexibility. Additionally, leveraging blockchain-based payments reduces the risk of chargebacks and allows creators to maintain full control over their payment processing infrastructure.

Infrastructure sovereignty empowers creators to take ownership of their digital commerce infrastructure, including payment processing, order storage, and file delivery. Furthermore, using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery enables creators to provide instant access to their ebooks, ensuring a seamless user experience. This level of automation and control is particularly beneficial for creators who value independence and flexibility in their digital commerce operations.
